thread:
Nina K: Quick sync — I'm drafting a 'partner iac packaging playbook'. Goal: a small, repeatable pipeline + checklist so partners can publish Terraform modules to marketplace or raw bundles with minimal hand-holding. Objections?
Devon L: none from me. We need to be explicit about artifact types, signing, SBOMs, metadata schema, and the staging index.
Priya S: call out per-marketplace fields early. GCP wants licensing info in the manifest, AWS wants AMI mappings and listing docs, Azure requires an offerId and publisher contact.
Tom B: also include provider binary support matrix (arm64 vs x86). We hit provider pinning issues on Ampere last year.
Mika (partner-eng): partners will expect: 1) repo template 2) quickstart guide 3) compliance checklist. We should supply a one-click GH Actions workflow they can drop in.
Nina K: proposed artifacts from pipeline: module-bundle.tgz, metadata.json (schema-v1), ref-arch.zip (tiny example app), sbom.spdx, signature.asc. Keep ref-arch separate to avoid heavy downloads.
Devon L: CI/workflow outline: checkout -> terraform fmt/validate -> unit tests (terratest) -> static checks -> generate SBOM -> sign artifacts -> upload to staging -> smoke deploy -> update staging-index.json -> notify partner.
Priya S: security gating: SCA scan (GHAS/Snyk), deny publish on high-severity CVEs. Also run a static preflight for secrets/hardcoded creds.
Tom B: add a terraform-plan analyzer step that fails if plan tries to destroy non-test-owned infra. And a cost-guard on smoke deploys (daily cap + small instance types).
Mika (partner-eng): partners want immutable, versioned URLs and a changelog entry for each release. Include digest and multiple artifact mirrors (marketplace package URL, raw bundle, ref-arch).
Nina K: distribution channels: marketplace packaging (vendor-specific adapter required), raw-bundle (tar.gz with metadata), and a hosted index (static JSON on S3).
Devon L: I'll implement a reusable GH Action in redwood/actions/partner-package. Inputs: release_channel, target_cloud, run_smoke (bool), sign_key. Outputs: artifact URLs and metadata. I'll aim for a 2-week proto.
Priya S: metadata fields to include in schema-v1: name, version (semver), partner_id, vendor_fields (per-cloud), compatibility (terraform vs provider versions), status (published/deprecated/revoked), sbom_url, signature_url, changelog_url. I'll draft schema.md.
Tom B: revocation flow: set metadata.status=revoked in index, remove from marketplace if possible, rotate signatures if compromised, and run customer notify playbook. We should store revoked timestamp and reason.
Mika (partner-eng): onboarding: I'll collect partner marketplace requirements (thumbnails, legal contact, KMS preferences) and run two pilots: one SI and one hardware partner.
Nina K: tests: terratest matrix across AWS/GCP/Azure with tiny infra. Use ephemeral short-lived accounts and monitor spend.
Devon L: adapters: build a small template generator (python) that consumes module outputs and emits vendor packaging artifacts (e.g., AMI map, ARM overlay, listing manifest). Keep adapter plugins pluggable.
Priya S: compliance docs: include a privacy + dataflow doc for ref-arch and a KMS checklist. Partners miss KMS integration often.
Tom B: telemetry: allow opt-in usage ping in sample ref-arch (default off). Ship privacy doc and opt-out instructions with artifact.
Mika (partner-eng): partners asked for a short partner README showing: how to plug into the GH Action, expected artifact names, metadata example, and how to run the smoke tests locally. I can draft that.
release-bot: release 2791241111-candidate: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-staging/2791241111/ :rocket:
Nina K: next steps: Devon builds GH Action + repo template, Priya drafts metadata-schema.md and revocation-runbook, Mika preps partner pilot list. I'll author docs/partner-playbook.md in the repo.
Priya S: I'll also write email templates and incident notification templates for revoked/patched modules.
Tom B: add a quick checklist for marketplace reviewers (thumbnail, legal contact, KMS, data residency). Keep it one page.
Mika (partner-eng): I'll schedule pilot onboarding for week 1 next month and share partner requirements spreadsheet.
Nina K: thanks team. We'll reconvene after the GH Action proto.
